children: Toronto, Ontario – TheNewswire – November 09, 2026 – Loyalist Exploration Limited

(“Loyalist” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that, further to its press releases dated April 9, 2025, July 8, 2025 and September 26, 2025, it is issuing 13,400,000 common shares of the Company (the “Milestone Shares”) to Fulcrum Metals (Canada) Ltd. (“Fulcrum”), a subsidiary of Fulcrum Metals Plc, in satisfaction of a milestone payment under the property purchase agreement dated October 2, 2025 between the Company and Fulcrum (as amended, the “Purchase Agreement”) in respect of the Tully Gold Project (the “Tully Property”), located approximately 25 km northeast of Timmins, Ontario.

Under the Purchase Agreement, the Company agreed to issue 15,000,000 common shares to Fulcrum (of which, 1,600,000 shall be issued at a later date (the “Deferred Shares”) upon the filing of a technical report on the Tully Property in which the gold resource is re-evaluated (or restated) to a National Instrument 43‑101 standard and the total gold resource exceeds 200,000 ounces. This milestone was achieved upon the filing of a technical report on the Tully Property under the Company’s profile on SEDAR+ on August 21, 2026. The Milestone Shares are subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance in accordance with applicable securities laws.

Ryan Mee, Chief Executive Officer of Fulcrum Metals plc, commented: “We’re pleased to increase our shareholding in Loyalist through this agreement. Achieving the resource milestone is an important step for Tully. Fulcrum remains a supportive shareholder, and we look forward to seeing the Loyalist team build on that progress as it advances the project.”

Errol Farr, Chief Executive Officer of Loyalist commented: “We’re pleased to have achieved this important resource milestone on the Tully Gold Project and to issue the corresponding Milestone Shares to Fulcrum. The updated NI 43-101 technical report confirmed a total gold resource exceeding 200,000 ounces and further validates the work completed to date. We value Fulcrum’s continued support as a significant shareholder and look forward to systematically advancing Tully while continuing to grow the deposit.

Neither the Canadian Securities Exchange nor its Market Regulator (as that term is defined in the policies of the Canadian Securities Exchange) have reviewed or accept responsibility for the adequacy or accuracy of this release.

Loyalist is a Canadian mineral exploration and development company focused on creating long-term shareholder value through the advancement of high-quality mineral projects in Timmins, Ontario. The Company's flagship 100%-owned Tully Gold Project, located in the prolific Timmins Gold Camp of northeastern Ontario, is a growing underground gold project with significant exploration upside and excellent development potential. Supported by a high-confidence Indicated and Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate, favourable infrastructure, and a modern geological model, Tully provides a strong platform for continued development and expansion. Loyalist's strategy is to systematically advance the Tully Gold Project to production while growing the deposit and continuing to evaluate opportunities to expand its portfolio of high-quality mineral assets. The Company also looks forward to advancing exploration activities on its three other Timmins based projects – DeSantis, Gold Rush and Loveland. The Company is committed to maintaining the highest standards of technical excellence and responsible development throughout all stages of project advancement.
